paragraphs: CAT M1 series filters are designed to reduce maximum particle size to 0.01µm and oil concentration to 0.003mg/m3 in compressed air, delivering as per ISO 8573.1 Class 1.

These filters employ state-of-the-art Borosilicate glass fibre as filter media in addition to Activated carbon. The filter housing is made of aluminium alloy and has a maximum operating pressure of 16 bar g.
SANPAR CAT-M1 Series filters are capable of filtering unwanted dust, oil, oil vapor and odour from the medical air. These contaminants can damage critical equipments like ventilators.
Precision-engineered solutions in compressed air treatment and industrial cooling, trusted globally for over 31 years.

CAT M1 series filters are designed to reduce maximum particle size to 0.01µm and oil concentration to 0.003mg/m3 in compressed air, delivering as per ISO 8573.1 Class 1.
These filters employ state-of-the-art Borosilicate glass fibre as filter media in addition to Activated carbon. The filter housing is made of aluminium alloy and has a maximum operating pressure of 16 bar g.
SANPAR CAT-M1 Series filters are capable of filtering unwanted dust, oil, oil vapor and odour from the medical air. These contaminants can damage critical equipments like ventilators.
Contact Us
Salient Features
Filters unwanted dust, oil, oil vapour and odour in the medical air for breathing purpose.
Applied to critical applications such as ventilators and medical equipments.
Installed for the generation and purification of oxygen and nitrogen gas.
Multi-layered filtration by the use of Borosilicate Glass Fibre filtration media and activated carbon.
Conforming to ISO 8573.1 Class 1 standards
Breathing quality air as per EN12021-2014.
Dust filtration up to 0.01µm.
Oil concentration up to 0.003 mg/m3.
Available from 5-500 Cfm.
